notes: Form 10-K for fiscal 2000 with the pre-2003 numbering: Item 14 is exhibits, financial statement schedules and reports on Form 8-K, so no Item is absent. Risk factors are an unnumbered subsection of Item 1. Item 7 is printed 'ITEM 7.MANAGEMENT'S ...' with no space. Item 8 prints the full financial statements. Items 4 ('None.') and 9 ('None') are nil answers and are marked incorporated, following the field definition in bench/src/labels.rs. Items 10 to 13 only incorporate the proxy statement. Item 14 ends at SIGNATURES, the filing end; the index to exhibits follows the signatures. Adjudicated from two independent labels, which agreed on every Item start and on the end and differed only on the incorporated flag for the nil answers.
